context:
Reproduce the failure shape locally before changing kill logic. Prefer a
small, portable subprocess-tree fixture in tests over relying on a slow real
benchmark. Keep report changes additive so existing parsers can still read old
fields.
description:
The 2026-05-12 enabled-platform UAT config set `per_cell_timeout_s: 600`, but
the run notes indicate timeout enforcement did not reliably stop long cells.
The artifact matrix reported no timed-out cells even though the full command
ran for 1036.4s and execution did not cover the full enumerated matrix.

Current unit coverage exercises a simple child process timeout. The UAT cell
path runs `uv run -- benchbox ...`, which can create a larger process tree and
buffered stdout/stderr behavior. Add targeted regression coverage and harden
timeout handling so a per-cell timeout kills the whole cell process tree and
is reported unambiguously as timed out.

anti_patterns.dont: add sleeps long enough to slow the fast suite materially
infer the exact timeout root cause solely from the 2026-05-12 artifacts; write a reproducer first
treat timeouts as ordinary failed cells in summaries

deferrals.reason: The immediate defect is per-cell kill/report behavior; platform-level scheduling policy is separate.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] non-actionable: A 'global runtime scheduler redesign' is a vague, large, speculative redesign with no concrete driver; the load-bearing per-cell timeout/kill fix landed in the from-item. No defined need or trigger.

preserves.behavior: A timed-out cell cannot leave child processes running after the test or UAT phase exits
Non-timeout failures retain their original return code and stderr context
Timeout tests remain fast and do not require live Docker or cloud credentials

prior_art.concept: tests/uat/phases/execute.py -- execution phase consumes timeout settings and aggregates cell results
tests/uat/runner.py:123-166 -- `run_cell()` invokes `benchbox_run_argv()` and maps timeout status into `CellResult`
tests/uat/test_timeouts.py -- existing unit tests cover simple timeout behavior but not benchbox-like process trees
tests/uat/timeouts.py:29-89 -- `run_with_timeout()` currently uses `subprocess.Popen`, process groups, and timeout handling

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/uat/test_timeouts.py tests/uat/test_runner.py -m fast -q
verifications.description: Timeout and runner unit coverage passes
Targeted UAT timeout smoke records a timed-out cell
verifications.expected: `cells.jsonl` and `matrix_summary.tsv` mark the synthetic cell as timed out with no surviving child process

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/uat/test_matrix.py tests/uat/test_phases.py -m fast -q
verifications.description: Existing UAT matrix coverage still passes

work_units.notes:
Build a local synthetic command that mimics `uv run -- benchbox` spawning
descendants and sleeping beyond a tiny timeout. Record a compact summary
of process tree, command, exit status, and whether descendants survived.

Completed with fast regression coverage in
`tests/uat/test_timeouts.py`: a parent process spawns a sleeping
grandchild, the wrapper times out at 1s, returns exit 124, and the child
PID is gone before the assertion completes.
work_units.summary: Reproduce timeout behavior with a benchbox-like process tree

work_units.notes:
Extend timeout/runner tests beyond a one-process `time.sleep`. Cover a
child that spawns a grandchild, a command that writes output, and the
`run_cell()` status mapping. Tests must be deterministic and fast.

Added process-tree, noisy-pipe, and `run_cell()` timeout marker tests.
The timeout/runner verification command passed: 21 tests.

Ensure timeout handling terminates the process group or process tree,
escalates if needed, drains output safely, and returns a stable timeout
code/status that matrix and report phases classify as timed out rather
than failed or missing.

`run_with_timeout()` now uses `communicate(timeout=...)` so stdout/stderr
pipes are drained while the timeout is enforced. Timeout classification
remains stable at exit 124 with `timed_out=True`, and `run_cell()` writes
a compact `UAT_TIMEOUT` marker into the cell log.
work_units.summary: Harden timeout kill and reporting semantics

work_units.notes:
Make timed-out cells visible in `cells.jsonl`, `matrix_summary.tsv`, and
reports. Include enough command/status context to debug future timeouts
without committing raw logs.

`cells.jsonl` now includes a boolean `timed_out` field. Existing report
output already counted timed-out cells separately; the synthetic timeout
smoke confirmed `failed=0 timed_out=1`.
work_units.summary: Expose timeout accounting in matrix and report outputs
